role: Owns the SettingsManager singleton: loads/saves UserSettings JSON (user_settings.json in the App Group container) with a protection-aware don't-clobber guard, off-main coalesced writes, CloudKit export/restore hooks, custom tags, baseline updates, device-local disclaimer flag and trial-clock helpers.
types: SettingsManager.WriteState: struct (private) — pending snapshot + scheduled flag for the write queue
FileReadFailure: enum (file scope) — locked | gone | nothingToKeep | transient: what a failed read of a stored file means for writing over it; shared with BaselineTracker
state: mem:SettingsManager.settings (@Observable UserSettings; didSet persists + posts notification)
mem:SettingsManager.lockedStartingPoint (settings the app started from while saves were held; diff base for the unlock merge)
mem:SettingsManager.settingsSnapshot / snapshotBox (OSAllocatedUnfairLock mirror for off-main readers)
file:<AppGroup>/user_settings.json — SettingsManager.settingsURL, the file in use (the legacy <Documents>/user_settings.json while the migration copy fails; deleted after a verified copy)
ud:perf.enableAIAssistant / perf.enableVoiceMode / perf.enableWatchConnectivity (standard; mirrors written in save())
file:<settings dir>/user_settings.unreadable.json (copy of a settings file that existed but could not be read; SettingsManager.unreadableBackupName; written atomically from the bytes read)
toplevel: `nonisolated static let shared = SettingsManager()` creates the singleton lazily on first touch from any thread; settingsWriteQueue and writeState are created as stored-property initializers. Notification.Name.flowRecoverySettingsChanged = "FlowRecoverySettingsChanged". FileReadFailure (file-scope enum) classifies read errors for SettingsManager and BaselineTracker.

units.does: didSet of the settings property: updates the lock-backed snapshot, saves through saveUnlessLocked (skipped, logged, while the file is locked — the change is merged on unlock), and always posts flowRecoverySettingsChanged.
units.entry: Swift property observer: runs on every assignment to SettingsManager.settings (all Settings UI bindings, services).

units.does: True while saving would write over a file this launch could not read and has no copy of: loadOutcome is .blockedByProtection or .unreadableNotPreserved.
Nonisolated accessor returning the latest settings value from the lock-backed snapshot box, for off-main readers.

Private nonisolated init: resolves (and migrates) the settings URL, loads it, records the LoadOutcome, seeds settings and the snapshot with the loaded value or UserSettings() defaults, keeps those defaults as lockedStartingPoint when saves are held (blocked by protection, or .unreadableNotPreserved), schedules the protected-data observer in both held cases, and installs background/terminate flush observers.
units.entry: Called once by the static `shared` initializer on first access (EmuquApp.swift:152 and AppDependencies).

branches.effect: UserSettings() defaults are used in memory
a MainActor Task installs the protectedDataDidBecomeAvailable observer

units.does: Returns <AppGroup container>/user_settings.json; if that file is absent but <Documents>/user_settings.json exists, copies the legacy file into the App Group first and then has removeMigratedLegacyFile delete the original once the copy reads back identical; when the copy fails it returns the Documents URL, so this launch reads and saves the user's settings there and the copy is retried next launch.

branches.cond: guard: App Group file absent AND Documents URL resolves AND legacy file exists
branches.effect: any false: return App Group URL without migration; all true: attempt copy
log a warning and return the legacy Documents URL (migration retried on the next launch, since the App Group file still does not exist)

units.does: Reads the App Group copy and the Documents original; when the bytes are identical deletes the original, otherwise logs and keeps it. A read or delete error is logged and the original stays.

Installs observeSuspension for UIApplication.didEnterBackground and willTerminate: each saves changes held for an unreadable file with no copy and then synchronously flushes any pending settings write.

Registers a main-queue observer for the notification that, on the main actor, runs saveHeldChangesBeforeSuspend and then flushPendingWritesSynchronously (its returned error is discarded; the write logs it).

Only while loadOutcome == .unreadableNotPreserved and something was changed while held (hasHeldChanges): runs retryHeldLoad, which re-reads the file and saves the held changes once it can. Without a change nothing is read or written.

branches.cond: not held for an unread file, or no held change

units.does: True when lockedStartingPoint is set and differs from the in-memory settings (a change was made while saves were held).

Static loader (internal; `read` is a test seam defaulting to Data(contentsOf:)): missing file → (nil,.fileNotPresent); read throws → logged, (nil, outcome(forReadError:)) — .blockedByProtection, .fileNotPresent, .unreadableOther (nothing to keep) or .unreadableNotPreserved (may be intact; saves held); read → decodeOrPreserve (decoded → .loaded; undecodable bytes written aside → .unreadableOther; copy failed → .unreadableNotPreserved).
Maps FileReadFailure(error): locked → .blockedByProtection; gone → .fileNotPresent; nothingToKeep → .unreadableOther; transient → .unreadableNotPreserved.

Decodes UserSettings (iso8601) from the bytes → (settings,.loaded). On a decode error logs and writes the bytes beside the file (preserveUnreadableBytes): (nil,.unreadableOther) when written, (nil,.unreadableNotPreserved) — saves held — when not.

Writes the given bytes of an undecodable settings file to user_settings.unreadable.json beside it (atomic, completeFileProtectionUntilFirstUserAuthentication, so an older copy is replaced only by a complete new one); logs and returns true, or logs at .error and returns false.
Installs (once) a main-queue observer for protectedDataDidBecomeAvailable that hops to the MainActor and calls retryLoadAfterUnlock.
Runs retryHeldLoad; when saves stay held (still locked, or the file still cannot be read or kept) logs, and the observer stays for the next unlock.

Re-runs load(from:read:) and records the outcome. Still held (.blockedByProtection or .unreadableNotPreserved): returns false, changes stay in memory. Otherwise removes the protected-data observer, adoptAfterUnlock(loaded) (held changes merged onto the file's settings, or saved when the file is gone or a copy was kept), true.

Clears lockedStartingPoint; with loaded settings assigns them merged with every field changed while held (merging(changesFrom:to:onto:) from the starting point, or them as they are without one; didSet saves and notifies) and logs; with none (file gone, or unreadable with a copy kept) saves the in-memory settings only when they differ from the starting point, so unchanged defaults are not written over the file.

branches.effect: merge; otherwise take the loaded settings as they are

branches.cond: no loaded settings and a change was made while held

units.does: Removes the protected-data observer from NotificationCenter and clears it; no-op when none is installed.

Encodes base, changed and disk settings to top-level JSON fields; for every key whose value differs between base and changed (compared as NSObject), sets (or removes) that key in the disk fields from changed; decodes the result as UserSettings. Any encode/decode failure is logged as a warning and returns disk unchanged.

branches.cond: for each key in base ∪ changed whose values differ
branches.effect: take changed's value (nil removes the key)

units.does: Encodes settings with an ISO-8601 JSONEncoder and returns the top-level JSON object as [String: Any]; throws CocoaError.coderReadCorrupt if it is not an object.

branches.cond: top level is not a dictionary

units.does: Delete-All-My-Data reset. While saves are held (file locked, or unreadable with no copy kept) it deletes user_settings.json (removal needs no read), marks the outcome .fileNotPresent, drops the starting point and the unlock retry (so it cannot load the erased settings back). Then deletes the unreadable-file copy, assigns fresh UserSettings() (didSet persists defaults) and clears the device-local disclaimer flag.

branches.effect: delete the held file, outcome .fileNotPresent, clear starting point, remove observer; otherwise straight to the reset

units.does: Deletes the file at url when it exists; a failure is logged at .error naming `what`.

Saves the settings unless saves are held. Blocked by file protection: logs a warning and leaves the change in memory for retryLoadAfterUnlock to merge. .unreadableNotPreserved: retryHeldLoad re-reads the file and, once it reads (or its bytes are kept, or it is gone), merges or saves the held changes; still held, logs and leaves the change in memory. Otherwise save().

branches.cond: loadOutcome == .unreadableNotPreserved and the file still cannot be read or kept

units.does: Writes the three performance flags (enableAIAssistant, enableVoiceMode, enableWatchConnectivity) to standard UserDefaults and enqueues an off-main disk write of the current settings.

Flushes the pending settings write synchronously (flushPendingWritesSynchronously) and throws its error if that write failed; then reads user_settings.json, decodes it (ISO-8601) and returns whether it equals `expected` after `expected` is encoded and decoded the same way (so decoder-filled fields such as the schema version do not count). Read and decode errors are thrown.

Stores the snapshot as the pending write under the lock and, if no drain is scheduled, dispatches drainPendingWrites onto the utility write queue (latest-wins coalescing; the drain's returned error is discarded, the write logs it).

branches.effect: return (the running drain picks up the new pending snapshot); false: async-dispatch a drain

units.does: Loops writing pending snapshots to disk until takePendingWrite returns nil; returns the error of the last write it made (nil when it succeeded or nothing was pending).

branches.effect: write it, keeping its error as the last outcome; loop ends when none (scheduled cleared)

units.does: Under the lock pops the pending snapshot; when none, clears the scheduled flag and returns nil.

branches.effect: scheduled=false, return nil; else clear pending and return it

units.does: Encodes the snapshot as pretty, sorted-key ISO-8601 JSON, writes it atomically to user_settings.json and sets completeUntilFirstUserAuthentication protection, returning nil; any error is logged at .error (shown in Troubleshooting's Recent Problems) and returned.

branches.effect: logged at .error and returned to the drain; no retry

units.does: Synchronously runs drainPendingWrites on the settings write queue, blocking the caller until any pending write is on disk; returns that write's error, nil when it succeeded or none was pending.
units.entry: Called from the didEnterBackground / willTerminate NotificationCenter observers installed in installDurabilityObservers, and by flushedFileHolds (Delete All My Data's profile read-back).

units.does: Returns the in-memory settings encoded as pretty sorted ISO-8601 JSON for CloudKit push, or nil when the load outcome is blockedByProtection or unreadableOther (or encoding throws).

branches.effect: true: encode; false: return nil (push skipped)

units.does: Decodes a CloudKit settings JSON blob (throws on failure), forces loadOutcome to .loaded, clears lockedStartingPoint and assigns it to settings (didSet persists + notifies); when the restored copy carries a trial start, adoptTrialStart bridges it into the entitlement anchor and mirrors the resolved start back.
Appends a custom ReadingTag to settings.customTags unless one with the same id exists.

branches.cond: a tag with the same id already exists
branches.effect: return without change; otherwise append (didSet saves)

units.does: Removes all custom tags with the given tag's id.
Device-local disclaimer flag: getter reads disclaimerRevision (for observation) and UserDefaults bool; setter writes the bool and bumps disclaimerRevision.
Sets settings.baselineRMSSD and/or settings.baselineHR when the corresponding argument is non-nil (each assignment triggers a separate save + notification).
Static alias returning TrialPolicy.durationDays (30).

Days remaining in the trial: start = cached anchor trialStartDate ?? settings.trialStartDate; now = max(wall clock, anchor high-water mark); TrialPolicy.daysRemaining rounds up, 0 when unstarted/expired.

branches.cond: ?? — anchor cache has no trial start

units.does: True when trialDaysRemaining > 0.

Mirrors a trial start into settings: if the cached anchor already holds a start no later than the given one, mirrors that; otherwise adopts the given date into the anchor as a device start (resolve + persist) and mirrors the anchor's resulting start.

branches.cond: anchor has a start and it is <= the given start
branches.effect: mirror the anchor's start and return (always the case for StoreKitManager, which records the App Store start first); else adopt the given start into the anchor and mirror the anchor's result (a CloudKit-restored start from restoreFromJSON)

units.does: Assigns settings.trialStartDate = start when start is non-nil and differs from the stored value.

branches.cond: start is nil or equals settings.trialStartDate
branches.effect: return without change; else assign (didSet saves)

units.does: Stores now as the last trial-reminder date in standard UserDefaults.
True when the stored last trial-reminder date is today per Calendar.current.

Classifies a read error, taking the POSIX code from the error or its NSUnderlyingErrorKey: NSFileReadNoPermissionError → .locked; NSFileReadNoSuchFileError or ENOENT → .gone; NSFileReadTooLargeError or EISDIR → .nothingToKeep; anything else (EIO, EMFILE, a failed mapping, NSFileReadUnknownError) → .transient.
